title: The 4 Best Mini Fridges for Offices
h1: The 4 Best Mini Fridges for Offices
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for mini fridges for offices, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at mini fridges for offices using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Midea WHS-160RB1 4.4 Cu Ft Compact Refrigerator
products.blurb: Key specs: 4.4 cu ft capacity, 42 dB rated noise level, Reversible door with adjustable legs.
strengths: 42 dB rating is the quietest in this list, important in an open office
4.4 cu ft comfortably holds lunches for several coworkers
Reversible door adapts to tight break room corners
limitations: 33.86-inch height typically doesn't fit under a desk
Chiller compartment can't make ice or hold frozen food
Larger footprint takes real floor space in a break room
features: Small chiller compartment, not a true freezer

products.name: BLACK+DECKER BCRK25V 2.5 Cu Ft Compact Refrigerator
products.blurb: Key specs: 2.5 cu ft single-door capacity, 26.6-inch height, fits under most standard desks, ENERGY STAR certified, about 212 kWh/year.
strengths: 26.6-inch height clears most standard office desk openings
2.5 cu ft holds a full day's lunch and drinks comfortably
limitations: Small top freezer compartment barely holds an ice tray
Single glass shelf layout limits tall-container flexibility
features: 26.6-inch height, fits under most standard desks
Small freezer compartment with ice tray

products.name: Frigidaire EFR176 1.6 Cu Ft Retro Mini Fridge
products.blurb: Key specs: 1.6 cu ft capacity, 18.5-inch height, the smallest footprint in this list, Retro-styled body with a side-mounted bottle opener.
strengths: 18.5-inch height fits in the tightest under-desk or corner spaces
Retro styling stands out in a cubicle without looking out of place
Flush back allows placement directly against a wall or partition
limitations: 1.6 cu ft holds drinks and snacks, not a full lunch rotation for a team
Plastic door handle feels less durable over daily office use
Runs slightly louder than the Midea per owner reports
features: 18.5-inch height, the smallest footprint in this list
Retro-styled body with a side-mounted bottle opener

products.name: Galanz GLR31TBEER 3.1 Cu Ft Retro Mini Fridge
products.blurb: Key specs: 3.1 cu ft total, split into fridge and separate top freezer, True dual-door design with an actual freezer, Adjustable mechanical thermostat.
strengths: Only fridge in this list where a coworker can actually freeze something
Under-42 dB compressor keeps it quiet in a shared space
Split fridge/freezer layout organizes shared lunches better than one open compartment
limitations: Taller than a typical under-desk fridge
Pricier than the single-door options here
Plastic interior parts feel less sturdy under heavy shared use
features: 3.1 cu ft total, split into fridge and separate top freezer
True dual-door design with an actual freezer

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
